requirements.claim: Fourteen clinics across three states, about six hundred employees
requirements.source_quote: Fourteen clinics across three states, about six hundred employees total

requirements.claim: Spend is concentrated: a clinic manager per clinic plus a small central team of finance, procurement, facilities and compliance
requirements.source_quote: each clinic has a clinic manager who buys supplies, and then there's a small central team — finance, procurement, facilities, and Millie's compliance group

requirements.claim: Two regional operations directors, Sam Ionescu and Karen Doyle, plus facilities lead Bruno
requirements.source_quote: Two regional ops directors, me and Karen Doyle. We travel between clinics constantly. And our facilities lead, Bruno, who handles repairs and contractors.

requirements.claim: Clinic managers get $4,000 per month with a $1,000 per-transaction cap
requirements.source_quote: We want four thousand a month per clinic manager, with a per-transaction cap of a thousand.

requirements.claim: Purchases over $1,000 must route through procurement rather than a card
requirements.source_quote: Anything over a thousand in one purchase should go through procurement, not on a card.

requirements.claim: Clinic manager categories: medical supply houses, pharmacies, hardware stores, cleaning suppliers
requirements.source_quote: Medical supply houses, pharmacies, hardware stores, cleaning suppliers, that kind of thing.

requirements.claim: Clinic manager cards must not work for travel, restaurants or electronics retail
requirements.source_quote: Definitely no travel, no restaurants, no electronics retail.

requirements.claim: REQ-1: no Apex card may transact with the terminated supplier, enforced at merchant level
requirements.source_quote: No Apex card may complete a transaction with the terminated supplier operating

requirements.claim: REQ-1: the prohibited vendor trades under two names, Joe's Medical Supply and JMS Distribution
requirements.source_quote: They operate under Joe's Medical Supply and also as JMS Distribution, same outfit.

requirements.claim: REQ-1: category-level controls are explicitly insufficient because the vendor is a medical supplier
requirements.source_quote: Category-level controls are NOT sufficient: the Prohibited

requirements.claim: REQ-1: the block must apply to every card including temporary and contractor cards
requirements.source_quote:
must apply to every card issued under the program,
including temporary and contractor cards.

requirements.claim: Regional directors get $3,000 per month for travel: hotels, flights, rental cars, meals
requirements.source_quote: Karen and I get travel cards — three thousand a month, hotels, flights, rental cars, meals.

requirements.claim: Bruno in facilities gets $2,500 per month for hardware and contractors
requirements.source_quote: Bruno in facilities: twenty-five hundred a month, hardware, contractors, that world.

requirements.claim: Central finance team gets $500 each
requirements.source_quote: Central finance team, minimal — five hundred each for odds and ends.

requirements.claim: REQ-2: physical cards over $10,000 per month must not transact until a notarized wet-ink form is on file
requirements.source_quote:
Physical cards with a monthly limit exceeding $10,000 USD must remain
incapable of transacting until the Compliance Office confirms receipt

requirements.claim: REQ-2: the activation gate must fail closed
requirements.source_quote:
The activation gate must fail closed: absent confirmation, the card must not
transact.

requirements.claim: REQ-2: enforcement must be by the card system, not by staff memory
requirements.source_quote: I don't want "we'll remember not to use it." I want it physically unable to work until we say so.

requirements.claim: REQ-3: transactions over $500 must be declined at authorization without a matching open PO from NetSuite
requirements.source_quote:
Transactions exceeding $500 USD must be declined at authorization unless a
valid open Purchase Order number from the Apex ERP (NetSuite) is associated
with the transaction prior to authorization.

requirements.claim: REQ-3: Compliance will review a compensating control where pre-authorization matching is unavailable
requirements.source_quote:
where pre-authorization matching is not technically available, Compliance will
review the tightest available compensating control

requirements.claim: REQ-3: the vendor response must state which side of the line the platform falls on
requirements.source_quote:
Vendor response must state clearly which side of
that line the platform falls on.

requirements.claim: REQ-4: contract staff cards must cease functioning on the assignment end date without human action
requirements.source_quote:
Cards issued to contract clinical staff must automatically cease functioning
on the assignment end date without human action.

requirements.claim: REQ-4: end dates must be editable if an assignment is extended
requirements.source_quote:
End dates must be editable
if an assignment is extended.

requirements.claim: Traveling nurses: eight to twelve at a time, assignments of thirty to ninety days
requirements.source_quote: typically eight to twelve at any time, on assignments of thirty to ninety days

requirements.claim: Traveling nurses get $1,500 per month for lodging, meals and fuel
requirements.source_quote: Fifteen hundred a month, lodging, meals, gas.

requirements.claim: The vendor block applies to the nurses' cards as well — company-wide
requirements.source_quote: Same vendor block applies, obviously — everything gets the Joe's block.

requirements.claim: REQ-5: the Compliance Office needs read-only access to all transactions, cards, limits and users
requirements.source_quote:
The Compliance Office must hold read-only access to all transactions, cards,
limits, and users: full visibility, no spend capability, no administrative
capability.

requirements.claim: REQ-6: receipts required for every transaction regardless of amount
requirements.source_quote: Receipts are required for every transaction regardless of amount.

requirements.claim: Clinic manager spend auto-approves within limits
requirements.source_quote: Clinic managers' spend auto-approves within their limits — that's what the limits are for.

requirements.claim: Central team spend over $500 requires manager approval; compliance escalations go to Gordon Pryce
requirements.source_quote: Central team, manager approval over five hundred. And anything Millie's team flags goes to me.

requirements.claim: Dana Whitfield and Gordon Pryce administer the account
requirements.source_quote: Our controller, Dana Whitfield, plus me.

requirements.claim: Clinic managers must be live in three weeks; the nurses programme can follow
requirements.source_quote: We want clinic managers live in three weeks. The nurses program can follow.

requirements.claim: Every requirement must be answered ENFORCED BY PLATFORM, ENFORCED BY PROCESS or NOT MET
requirements.source_quote:
Each requirement must be
answered as one of: ENFORCED BY PLATFORM / ENFORCED BY PROCESS / NOT MET.

requirements.claim: Vague vendor responses will be returned
requirements.source_quote:
Vague
responses ("the platform supports robust controls") will be returned.

requirements.claim: The acceptable fallback is the tightest control that is audit-proof, not necessarily the maximal ask
requirements.source_quote: What Millie will actually accept, if the ideal isn't possible, is the tightest thing that gets us audit-proof.

requirements.claim: Only a handful of cards would exceed the $10,000 threshold, but the control must exist regardless
requirements.source_quote: The number doesn't matter. The control has to exist.
